title: DEBATE: In Light of Contemporary Physics, Does Physical Reality Have a Cause or Beginning?
description:
In this debate, atheist philosopher Dr. Daniel Linford and Christian philosopher Dr. Andrew Loke debate the topic: "In light of contemporary physics, we should not accept that the totality of physical reality had a cause or a beginning." Dr. Linford is taking the affirmative position and will go first.

The structure of the debate is as follows:
10-12 minute Opening Statements
10-minute First Rebuttals
50-minute Prepared Question Period
